definitions.explanation: A warrior or samurai of the pre-modern era. In modern use, appears in historical contexts, festival names (the Boy's Day {五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}), and set expressions such as {武者震|むしゃぶる}い (a thrill of anticipation before a challenge).

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう}→五月人形：27110_gogatsuningyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{武者|むしゃ}⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: We displayed a warrior doll among the Boy's Day figures for our son.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{武者|むしゃ}{震|ぶる}いがして、⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}いて→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧きた。
examples.english: Before the tournament I had a shiver of anticipation, which actually filled me with energy.

notes:
An older word, mainly used in historical and ceremonial contexts. Everyday modern speech uses ⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧ or ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {武者|むしゃ}⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧: warrior doll (Boy's Day display)
- {武者|むしゃ}⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: warrior training; (figurative) honing one's skills through hardship
- {武者|むしゃ}{震|ぶる}い: a thrill of anticipation before a challenge
- ⟦{落|お}ち→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{武者|むしゃ}: a defeated warrior fleeing battle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧: samurai — more common everyday word for a warrior of that class
- ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: soldier — modern, general term
- ⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧: warrior class member — emphasizes social class
